audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 at 55.6% over 268 games: Talon bullies the whole lane, ASol only takes over at 2+ items — both layers already carry this arc.
Spikes right in shape (bully 3-5, still win 6, first-item deletes, late ASol) but several spike texts mis-slot his abilities — corrected under point 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Astral Flight his E and claims it 'only exists at 6' — Astral Flight is his W (22s cd at rank 1, learnable early); Singularity is his E. spikes[1] calls Singularity part of his R. spikes[3] and late claim a 'true-damage stun' on his stacked Q — no true damage or stun exists on Q in Riot's text (the stun is on Falling Star/The Skies Descend). Singularity's center-execute was absent from the page.
audit.why: Kit file: W = Astral Flight cd 22/20.5/19/17.5/16; E = Singularity cd 12, percentHealth + execute flags, 'center of the black hole executes enemies below a threshold'; R = Falling Star/The Skies Descend, hardCC. Q text has no stun and no true damage.
audit.corrected: All slot references fixed to W/E correctly; 'only exists at 6' removed; 'true-damage stun' replaced with the real R stun; Singularity execute added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 3 lint findings: 2 copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d), cooldowns without a digit.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Late a stacked breath, huge health and Astral Flight out-last your jump — pick him only when W is down.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Assassin's Path has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight (W): 22s at rank 1 — his reposition and escape; he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Singularity (E) is 12s and executes below a threshold at its center — never limp-walk through it. Your E is for the moment it goes wrong; the R for when it goes right.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: Every stack he farms is future damage — W the step-up, Q the gap, auto the third stack, and tax the farm he needs to scale.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave feeds him free stacks and plates while you commute — shove it in before every roam.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain yours since he still lacks mobility and stacks to survive your all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 remain yours: with few stacks and a 22s W escape, he can't survive a timed all-in.

edits.before: ASol is a scaling stacker with zero early kill pressure, so bully him now. W-slow, Q in and autoweave before he has stacks or mana; his Breath of Light (Q) does little in a short trade and his Astral Flight (E) only exists at 6. Deny his farm and starve his stacks.
edits.after: ASol is a scaling stacker with zero early kill pressure, so bully him now. W-slow, Q in and autoweave before he has stacks or mana; his Breath of Light (Q) does little in a short trade and Astral Flight (W) is a 22s-cooldown escape he can't spam. Deny his farm and starve his stacks.

edits.before: You still win the all-in: your burst plus Shadow Assault kills him before his R (Falling Star/Singularity) matters, and pre-flight-cooldown he can't escape your Q reset. Force the fight before he E-flies away and keep his stack count low.
edits.after: You still win the all-in: your burst plus Shadow Assault kills him before his R (Falling Star) matters, and with Astral Flight (W) down he can't escape your Q reset. Force the fight while his W is on its 22s cooldown and keep his stack count low.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol hard-scales: stacked Q with the true-damage stun, huge health, and Astral Flight mobility let him kite and outlast your all-in. Once he's stacked, your jump gets flown away from; pick him only when E is down and end the game before then.
